verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented bulk operations such as multi-select edit, tag, move, or delete. The API only covers single-item calls (append to daily note, create a note, list or create links), and note contents are inaccessible to it because of end-to-end encryption. Adjacent features like one-time imports, Kindle sync, and chatting with a filtered set of notes are ingestion or read-only querying, not bulk actions on many existing items, so they earn no credit.
